title: NeuroTUMBCI2025: Motor imagery dataset from the neuroTUM 2024 Cybathlon BCI
description: A mobile EEG motor imagery dataset from two pilots, one tetraplegic and one able-bodied, recorded during development of the neuroTUM brain-computer interface for the 2024 Cybathlon BCI race. Data were acquired with a 24-channel wireless Smarting mobi system at 250 Hz using an arrow-cue paradigm with subject-specific sets of three mental tasks (rest, hand and/or foot motor imagery). The dataset is re-released in BIDS format with HED annotations via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 24-channel Smarting mobi (mBrainTrain) wireless amplifier at 250 Hz using a 10-20 montage. Each trial comprised a 3 s fixation reset, a 1 s directional arrow cue, a 3 s black-screen motor imagery execution period, and a 3 s reset. Classes were rest, left hand, right hand and feet, with each participant performing a subject-specific subset of three tasks over multiple sessions.
